<b>Frey</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|merchant]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. She sells wares at her shop in [[Bellhart]] in exchange for [[Rosaries]].

== Background ==
Frey is Bellhart's shopkeeper. She was able to avoid being ensnared during Bellhart's [[Haunting]] by shutting herself in her bellhome. She sustained herself off her store's supplies while she waited for the Haunting to pass.<ref>Frey: <i>"When that strange thread struck down from above, I shut up tight and huddled in my bellhome. Might've been a problem for the others about here, but my store was flush with supplies, so no fear I'd go hungry."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
After [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] defeats [[Widow]] and frees Bellhart from the Haunting, Frey sells her wares to Hornet in exchange for [[Rosaries]]. 

Frey also offers the <i>[[My Missing Courier]]</i> [[wish]] from Bellhart's wishwall, and after completion, she expands her stock.

She begins selling furniture for Hornet's [[Bellhome]] after [[Bellhome Key]] has been used.

| Title1_Event1 = First encounter
| Title1_Dialogue1 = <b>If the <i>[[My Missing Courier]]</i> wish is already completed, and [[Widow]] is defeated before Hornet has ever visited Bellhart:</b><br>
{{HTalk|Greetings, shopkeeper. Given the hardships of the lands beyond these bells, your store seems in remarkable order.}}<br>
Aye, well, we've had our tough times too! Of once bustling Bellhart, only a few residents now remain.<br>
But things are turned around for old Frey! Ho, yes! The town at least feels briefly at peace, and my courier has returned with fresh goods to trade.<br>
Whether pilgrim or traveller, mine is the finest store you'll have the fortune to visit throughout our blighted lands.<br>
<hr/>
<b>If the <i>My Missing Courier</i> wish is already completed, and Widow is defeated after Hornet has visited Bellhart:</b><br>
{{HTalk|Greetings, shopkeeper. It seems you've recovered well from that silken affliction.}}<br>
Ah! Well, I'm a clever bug. When that strange thread struck down from above, I shut up tight and huddled in my bellhome.<br>
Might've been a problem for the others about here, but my store was flush with supplies, so no fear I'd go hungry.<br>
{{HTalk|Your preparedness served you well then, and it seems your store is still well-stocked.}}<br>
Oh yes, even my supplier is back to work, so I have plenty of goods to show you!<br>
| Title1_Event2 = First encounter (if 1. the <i>My Missing Courier</i> wish is not completed, and 2. if Widow is defeated before Hornet has ever visited Bellhart, or if Hornet has talked to [[Lace]] in the [[Choral Chambers]])
| Title1_Dialogue2 = {{HTalk|Greetings, shopkeeper. I'd ask to trade, but your store seems a little bare.}}<br>
Ahem! Well, yes. Our little town's seen some dire times, and now my courier's gone and got themself lost.<br>
But don't worry! I've a few small things, still! And if that courier ever makes it safely back, we'll have plenty more treasures to haggle over.<br>
<hr/>
<b>If the <i>My Missing Courier</i> wish is accepted:</b><br>
{{HTalk|He would have been wise to do so. If, on my travels, I happen upon the errant bug, I'll make sure to send him your way.}}

| Title1_Event3 = First encounter (if 1. the <i>My Missing Courier</i> wish is not completed, and 2. if Widow is defeated after Hornet has visited Bellhart, and Hornet hasn't talked to Lace in the Choral Chambers) 
| Title1_Dialogue3 = {{HTalk|Greetings, shopkeeper. It seems you've recovered well from that silken affliction.}}<br>
Ah! Well, I'm a clever bug. When that strange thread struck down from above, I shut up tight and huddled in my bellhome.<br>
Might've been a problem for the others about here, but my store was flush with supplies, so no fear I'd go hungry.<br>
{{HTalk|Your preparedness served you well then. Although... your store now seems quite bare.}}<br>
Ahem. Yes. I'll admit, the wait was longer than I'd anticipated, and a bug has to eat...<br>
I'll have more to offer you once my courier turns up. No doubt he's been avoiding Bellhart since the curse set its sights on us.<br>
<hr/>
<b>If the <i>My Missing Courier</i> wish is accepted:</b><br>
{{HTalk|He would have been wise to do so. If, on my travels, I happen upon the errant bug, I'll make sure to send him your way.}}

| Title1_Event4 = After the <i>My Missing Courier</i> wish is accepted
| Title1_Dialogue4 = I saw it! Took my wish off the board, you did! Heading out after my stray courier, then?<br>
{{HTalk|My own tasks see me travel far, shopkeeper. If, on my journey, I happen upon the errant bug, I'll make sure to send them your way.}}<br>
Then you'll have my thanks and more! It's a rare bug who'd brave the wilds to aid a fellow.
| Title1_Event5 = After the wish is completed
| Title1_Dialogue5 = {{HTalk|Greetings again, shopkeeper. Your shelves are looking better stocked. I see the courier made their way back to you safely.}}<br>
Oh yes, the cheeky little so-and-so came by and dropped his cargo off at last.<br>
Poor dear was so shaken by his misadventures, I almost didn't have the heart to dock his earnings.<br>
All's well now, though! Take a look at the lovely new goods I have available!
| Title1_Event6 = Exhausted dialogue
| Title1_Dialogue6 = Hello again! Fancy buying something special before your tasks whisk you away?
| Title1_Event7 = Speaking while being [[Cursed Crest|cursed]]

{{HTalk|I will continue to live, madam, but I am indeed afflicted. A parasite has taken root within my shell... Perhaps you have something that could help me? A medicine?}} <br>
Mmm, not so sure I stock anything like that. You should ask Pavo there. It's his job to give directions and such, so he may have some useful advice. <br>
In the meantime... shopping itself is a type of medicine, isn't it? You should buy something now. Given your condition, this might be your last chance!
| Title1_Event8 = After receiving [[Bellhome Key]] from the <i>[[Bellhart's Glory]]</i> wish

However long you're with us, I've been holding onto some fine goods that'll cosy up your home. This stuff ain't for the riff-raff winding through, but a fellow Bellharter deserves the finest!
